prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity shippable 16:9 desktop homepage direction comp for VEEMAP Technologies
Input images: Image 1 is the visual-system quality bar for deep-pine multiplane cel animation; Image 2 is the hero-composition quality bar for layered depth and atmosphere; Image 3 is the authoritative VEEMAP orange-and-green double-chevron logo and must be preserved accurately, not redesigned.
Primary request: Design an ultra-premium VEEMAP Technologies homepage whose central hero is a physically credible, conceptually accurate, non-proprietary high-speed special-purpose automation machine shown in a precise exploded assembly state. Separate the frame, guarding, linear rails, precision nests, servo pick-and-place head, inspection camera, compact HMI, and conveyor modules onto clearly spaced depth planes along one disciplined assembly axis. Make the same exact machine visibly capable of resolving into its assembled state on scroll: include a restrained scroll progress rail reading “EXPLODED / ALIGN / ASSEMBLED” and a small crisp assembled-state silhouette/keyframe at the end of that rail. The machine must dominate the composition and read as real industrial engineering, not science fiction.
Visual world: deep pine, moss, mist grey and restrained lamp amber. Use painterly gouache atmosphere only behind and between mechanical focus planes to create depth; all metal geometry, UI, labels and callout lines remain crisp, machined and technically credible. No forest, leaves, cabin, fantasy landscape, storybook ornament, or rustic styling.
Layout: full 16:9 desktop browser viewport. Slim premium header with the accurate VEEMAP mark and wordmark at top left; navigation “CAPABILITIES   MACHINES   ENGINEERING   CAREERS”; compact header action “START A PROJECT”. Hero copy left or upper-left with strong editorial hierarchy; huge machine across center-right and lower center; callout labels anchored to real subsystems; bottom proof strip. Keep generous breathing room and make every element plausible to implement in a responsive website.
Text (verbatim): “SPECIAL PURPOSE. EXACT BY DESIGN.”; “World-class tools. In-house mechanisms. Machines engineered for exceptional speed and accuracy.”; “TELL US ABOUT YOUR PROCESS”; “AI VISION”; “HIGH-SPEED MOTION”; “INDUSTRY 4.0 HMI”; “PREDICTIVE HEALTH”; “236 PROJECTS DELIVERED”; “SCROLL TO ASSEMBLE”.
Typography: monumental high-contrast editorial serif only for the main headline, paired with a precise condensed industrial sans and small uppercase technical labels. All listed text must be crisp, correctly spelled, and readable. Do not add unrequested marketing claims.
Lighting/mood: dark cinematic commissioning bay, controlled amber edge light, mist only as shallow layered depth, impeccable contrast.
Constraints: real deployable web UI, clear primary CTA, central machine must be exact and coherent across exploded and assembled mini keyframe; preserve realistic proportions and visible mechanical logic; no proprietary RIEKE details; no component brands; no certifications; no testimonials; no client logos; no team size or revenue; no additional statistics; no people; no watermarks; no fantasy technology; no illegible decorative pseudo-text.
